## Procedure

- Run `git -C <base repo> worktree add <dir>/wt-amend-<n> -b run-unfiled-<ms> origin/main`, then prime it with `remudero-dependencies prime . --proof`.
- Change only `plan/tasks.d/W1-T<n>-<slug>.yaml`: add each missing path to `files`, or settle the design from the code.
- Add an `INVARIANT <slug>: <statement>` or a `NO-INVARIANTS: <reason>` line to `design`. lint-plan:fast does not check this; the review's design-invariant-proof check refuses it (AMEND12416b).
- Add a `reservation hand-off: <from branch> -> <to branch>` line to `note` when the filing branch does not hold the id reservation.
- Run `npm run lint-plan:fast` and confirm it reports 0 failing.
- Commit with `git commit -F <message file>`, subject `chore(plan): amend W1-T<n> <what changed>`, ending with the Co-Authored-By trailer.
- Run `amendbody.sh <worktree> <shard path> "<text the amendment adds>" <why-file> <out-body>`. It refuses unless the text is missing on origin/main and present on a non-comment line of the branch, then runs `./bin/rmd check-acceptance`.
- Run `ship.sh AMEND<n> <worktree> <branch> "<title>" <out-body>`, and ship the build with `AFTER_PR=<amendment PR>`.
- Say in the build's why-file that it depends on the amendment, and add any test the amendment names to the build's single commit (amend that unpushed commit; never merge the amendment branch into the build branch).

Boundaries: when the task's own filing PR is still open, add the `files` entries on that filing branch and do not open an amendment. A proof grep that matches only a YAML comment is refused ("executed_stale - every matching line is a comment").

## Evidence

- Azure hand lane: 66 amendment branches, 63 amendment bodies; ship logs record 23 waits for an amendment to merge.
- Mac hand lane: 208 AMEND entries in ~/rmd-hand/ship.
- Fleet fix rounds: 659 `fix.scope_amendment` and 299 `fix.scope_needed` ledger rows.
